Scope item: Authentication and role-based access control for four roles: Requester, Staff, Manager, Administrator
Service request submission with a mandatory controlled category
Requester visibility: current status and full history of own requests
In-app and email notification on accept, reject, update and completion
Staff work queue with search, filter and sort
Assignment, self-assignment and reassignment of requests
Controlled status lifecycle enforced as a state machine
Action, comment and resolution recording on a request
Management dashboard covering open, in progress, overdue, resolved and closed work
Breakdown of activity by category, status, assignee and period, with CSV export
Administration of the controlled category list and of users and roles
Immutable audit trail of status and assignment changes
Native mobile applications (iOS / Android)
Rationale / evidence required: Responsive web delivery satisfies SH-01 access needs at a fraction of the build, test and release cost. Two additional deployment targets cannot be verified within the schedule.

Scope item: WhatsApp, SMS or telephone channel integration
Rationale / evidence required: The fragmented-channel problem is solved by consolidating onto one controlled record, not by adding further channels. Paid gateways also breach CN-03.

Scope item: Integration with existing finance, ERP, HR or asset-management systems
Rationale / evidence required: No interface contract, test environment or owning stakeholder is available. Integration risk is unbounded and unverifiable.

Scope item: Payment, billing or procurement handling
Rationale / evidence required: No stakeholder need identified in the CivicConnect scenario.

Scope item: Multi-language and localisation support
Rationale / evidence required: No stakeholder has stated a language need. Adds string management to every subsequent change.

Scope item: Offline / disconnected operation with local synchronisation
Rationale / evidence required: Conflict resolution and sync integrity are disproportionate to the value at this scale.

Scope item: AI-based automatic triage, classification or prioritisation of requests
Rationale / evidence required: Rejected as scope creep. No training data, no accuracy acceptance criterion, and it would place an unverifiable component on the critical accountability path.

Scope item: External contractor / third-party supplier portal
Rationale / evidence required: Introduces an additional trust boundary and authorisation model that the security work in scope cannot cover.

Scope item: IoT or sensor-originated automatic request creation
Rationale / evidence required: No such source exists in the described environment.

Scope item: File and photograph attachments on a request
Rationale / evidence required: Requires object storage beyond the free tier, file-type and size validation, malware handling, and a retention/privacy obligation for images that may contain personal data. Deferred until the platform decision (DEC-008) establishes actual free-tier storage limits and until evidence exists of how often a photograph is genuinely required.

Scope item: Automated SLA timers and escalation rules
Rationale / evidence required: FR-021 currently identifies overdue work against a target resolution time per category. The target values have not been agreed with a stakeholder (RSK-05). Automating escalation on unvalidated thresholds would generate false escalations and erode trust in the system.

Scope item: SMS / push notification channel
Rationale / evidence required: Returns when a funded messaging budget exists, or when a free-tier gateway is identified that meets the notification volume in NFR-013 at zero cost. Retained on the register so the unmet SH-04 escalation expectation (CF-03) stays visible; residual exposure is RSK-08.

Scope item: Anonymous or confidential reporting channel
Rationale / evidence required: Resolves CF-01 but requires a separate authorisation and audit model. Deferred pending a decision on whether accountability can be preserved without identity.

Scope item: Bulk import of historical spreadsheet and paper records
Rationale / evidence required: Data quality of the legacy records is unknown. Migration cannot be specified until the persistence design exists (M2) and a sample extract has been inspected.

Scope item: Advanced analytics, trend reporting and scheduled report distribution
Rationale / evidence required: FR-019 to FR-022 satisfy the stated oversight need. Further analytics adds query and performance load against NFR-001 for value not yet evidenced.
